headline: Marban Hollow Flares As Linn Mercy Battle Quickens
war_summary: Since the morning edition the wires tell a shifted story, with Marban Hollow erupting and the Nevish Line stirring while Callahan's Passage falls silent. Marban Hollow counts 11 transfers in two hours, all of the day's 11, about Checkpoint Bua to the hour of this filing, with 24-hour losses at 136 Colonial and 299 Warden. The Nevish Line adds six in two hours after quiet, last heard at 1116, reaching 51 on the day about Mistle Shrine, Princefal, the Scrying Belt and others, with day losses at 12,012 Colonial and 14,530 Warden. Linn Mercy quickens to ten in two hours, twenty in six and forty-two on the day about Rotdust, Outwich Ranch and Lathair, also to the hour, with 9,087 Colonial and 11,782 Warden losses. The Weathered Expanse counts four in two hours, eleven in six and forty-five on the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, holding one Warden, five Colonial and three ruined posts. Mooring County eases to three in two hours, fourteen in six and nineteen on the day about the Wind Hills, last at 1130. Callahan's Passage records none in two hours, nine in six about Crumbling Post last at 1000, while Stonecradle remains still since yesterday.
